items.exampleEn: The proposed changes will be discussed next week.
items.exampleZh: 提議中的改變將在下週討論。

items.exampleEn: The company continues to assert its right to use the name.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司持續主張它有權使用這個名稱。

items.exampleEn: Nobody anticipated that the old song would become popular again.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人料到那首老歌會再度流行。

items.exampleEn: There is a general consensus among scientists that sleep is important for memory.
items.exampleZh: 科學家普遍一致認為，睡眠對記憶很重要。

items.exampleEn: The painting was once attributed to a famous artist.
items.exampleZh: 這幅畫曾被認為出自一位名畫家之手。

items.exampleEn: An estimated two hundred people came to the opening.
items.exampleZh: 估計有兩百人來參加開幕。

items.exampleEn: Frankly, I don't think the plan will work.
items.exampleZh: 坦白說，我不認為這個計畫行得通。

items.exampleEn: The two writers held very different ideologies.
items.exampleZh: 這兩位作家的思想體系非常不同。

items.sentenceEn: Frankly, the hotel was not as good as the photos suggested.
items.sentenceZh: 坦白說，那家飯店沒有照片看起來那麼好。

items.audioEn: The estimated time of arrival is six thirty, about twenty minutes late.
items.audioZh: 預計抵達時間是六點半，大約晚二十分鐘。

items.sentenceEn: We didn't anticipate so many guests, so we ran out of chairs.
items.sentenceZh: 我們沒料到會來這麼多客人，所以椅子不夠了。

items.sentenceEn: Experts attribute the drop in sales to the hot weather.
items.sentenceZh: 專家把銷售下滑歸因於炎熱的天氣。

items.stemEn: After hours of talking, the team still could not reach a ____.
items.stemZh: 談了好幾個小時，團隊還是無法達成共識。

items.stemEn: At the meeting, she ____ that her team had done nothing wrong.
items.stemZh: 會議上，她堅稱她的團隊沒有做錯任何事。

items.passageEn: At Monday's meeting, the manager presented the proposed move to a larger office. The estimated cost was high, so not everyone agreed. One colleague asserted that the move was unnecessary. "Frankly, our current office is fine," he said. Others anticipated that the team would grow next year and need more space. The manager attributed the team's recent success to good teamwork and said the new space would support it. It was a lengthy meeting, but the team finally reached a consensus: they would move in spring. For our manager, the belief that a company should invest in its people is almost an ideology, and this decision showed it again.
items.passageZh: 在星期一的會議上，經理提出了搬到更大辦公室的方案。估計費用很高，所以不是每個人都同意。一位同事堅稱沒有必要搬。他說：「坦白說，我們現在的辦公室就很好。」其他人則預期團隊明年會擴大，需要更多空間。經理把團隊最近的成功歸功於良好的團隊合作，並說新空間能支持這一點。會議開得很冗長，但團隊終於達成共識：他們春天搬家。對我們經理來說，「公司應該投資在員工身上」幾乎是一套信念體系，這個決定再次證明這一點。

questions.questionZh: 有一位同事為什麼反對搬遷？
options: 他認為現在的辦公室就很好
他打算明年就離開公司

questions.questionZh: 團隊最後達成什麼共識？

items.promptZh: 坦白說，我們需要更多時間才能完成這份報告。
referenceEn: Frankly, we need more time to finish this report.
Frankly speaking, we need more time to finish the report.
rubricZh: frankly 常放句首加逗號（例如 Frankly, …、Frankly speaking, …）
寫 To be honest 意思也對

items.promptZh: 這家店預期年底會非常忙碌。
referenceEn: The shop anticipates a very busy time at the end of the year.
The store anticipates being very busy at the end of the year.
rubricZh: anticipate 表示「預期」，後面可接名詞、動名詞或 that 子句
「年底」可寫，例如 at the end of the year、in December 等
寫成 The shop anticipates that it will be very busy… 也正確
